#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
#define MOD 1000000007
#define inf 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3f
#define pi acos(-1.0)
#define ri register int
#define int long long
#define all(x) x.begin(), x.end()
#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
const int maxn = 3e5 + 10;
#else
const int maxn = 1e3 + 10;
#endif
char str[maxn];
int N;
signed main() {
#ifdef ONLINE_JUDGE
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
#endif
    cin >> (str + 1);
    N = (int)strlen(str + 1);
    vector<vector<string>> dp(N + 1);
    dp[0].push_back("");
    for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
        if (i >= 2 && str[i - 1] == 'a' && str[i] == 't') {
            for (auto e : dp[i - 2]) {
                if (e.empty() || e.find('@') != string::npos) continue;
                dp[i].push_back(e + "@");
            }
        } else if (i >= 3 && str[i - 2] == 'd' && str[i - 1] == 'o' && str[i] == 't') {
            for (auto e : dp[i - 3]) {
                if (e.empty()) continue;
                dp[i].push_back(e + ".");
            }
        }
        for (auto e : dp[i - 1]) {
            dp[i].push_back(e + str[i]);
        }
    }
    vector<string> ans;
    for (auto e : dp[N]) {
        if (e.empty()) continue;
        if (e.find('@') != string::npos && e.back() != '@' && e.back() != '.') {
            ans.push_back(e);
        }
    }
    sort(all(ans));
    cout << ans.front() << endl;
    return 0;
}
